impact:
Two sides of one balance, user requirement 2026-10-20: an agent must never get stuck completely.
1. Too loose: baseline.subtract (hooks/lib/baseline.py:128-141) falls back to a rule-only count. If the baseline had 3 passive_voice hits and the agent rewrites them into 3 new passives, all 3 count as inherited and nothing blocks.
2. Too tight: T-035 makes the agent's own findings block every Stop. A false positive the agent cannot fix would then trap it forever.
For Sol QA: judge both with the no-trap constraint. Proposed: T-035 keeps blocking own findings up to a higher cap, then releases visibly and puts the finding list in front of the user; the loose match stays or narrows to the same paragraph.
resolution: Moved to T-045 (provenance by unit diff), target 0.29.0, plan in docs/plans/2026-10-20-finding-provenance.md.
title: Stop enforcement must never trap an agent, and the loose baseline match lets rewritten debt pass
